title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E06 — Taken in Tacoma
When 13-year-old Jennifer Bastian is abducted and murdered in August 1986, residents of Tacoma, Wash., panic; convinced a predator is on the loose, police embark on a 32-year inquiry to catch the killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E06 — Viciously Murdered
When Susan Schwarz is found shot to death in her apartment in 1979, police suspect a robbery gone wrong; thirty-two years pass before a witness reveals a much darker motive that breaks the case wide open and leads to Susan's killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E22 — The Bone Keeper
When human bones are discovered in the woods in December 1985, it puts an end to the search for missing teen David Reed; skull fractures point to murder, but it will be decades before investigators can find David's killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E27 — Lone Survivor
In early 1984, 3-year-old Vanessa Bennett becomes the lone survivor of her family's brutal murder; initial investigators suspect a serial killer is at large, but decades pass before DNA narrows the suspect pool to one man.

title: Tell Me How I Died
description:
S01 E07 — Crushing Suspicion
When a young woman dies in a car crash, it's up to the coroner's office to trigger an investigation into an accident that may have involved foul play.

title: Tell Me How I Died
description:
S01 E06 — Out of Reach
What begins as an open-and-shut case spins into a full-on investigation when a mother and son are found dead in their home.

title: Tell Me How I Died
description:
S01 E05 — Over the Edge
When a witness sees a nightclub owner jump to his death from his fifth floor condo, the case is seemingly open and shut; Dr. Jennifer Nara's autopsy reveals shocking new evidence.

title: The Killing of JonBenet: Her Father Speaks
description: John Ramsey responds to the media coverage surrounding the 20th anniversary of JonBenét's murder; a 1998 interview with JonBenét's brother, Burke; DNA evidence sheds new light on allegations that the killer may be a family member.

title: When Missing Turns to Murder
description:
S02 E08 — Louise Smith
When troubled teen Louise Smith goes missing, her family and the community come together to find her.

title: When Missing Turns to Murder
description:
S02 E03 — Cummings
When young Mark goes missing, family and police search frantically, only to find the answers were close to home.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E01 — Lost in the Leaves
A small town is shaken when a mother, her two children and her best friend mysteriously vanish; investigators find the family's home covered in blood but very few clues.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E02 — Tangled Affairs
When a beloved art teacher is murdered in her own home, her husband and a growing list of suspects face tough questions in the interrogation room.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E03 — A Betrayal of Trust
A man with a dark past is brought into the interrogation room after a woman is murdered and a young girl vanishes.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E04 — Bride-To-Be Murder Mystery
After a woman is brutally murdered just a week before her wedding, detectives interrogate three possible suspects, including her fiancé.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E05 — Murderous Friendship
A young mother mysteriously vanishes; as Pensacola investigators untangle a complicated web of friendships and finances, the woman she was last seen with is brought into the interrogation room.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E06 — Unrequited Love
A woman is murdered by the foster daughter she took in; an open-and-shut case becomes more complicated as evidence emerges that the foster daughter may not have acted alone.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S01 E07 — Conduct Unbecoming
A married Navy police officer faces tough questions after the woman he was having an affair with goes missing; a wife accused of murdering her husband, is finally interrogated after 10 years on the run.

title: Mobsters
description:
S01 E18 — Murder, Inc.
A ruthless gang called "Murder, Inc." carried out mob hits during the 1930s; Mob leaders formed The Syndicate, and as their enforcement arm, members of Murder, Inc. killed an estimated 1,000 people from coast to coast.

title: Mobsters
description:
S03 E06 — Big Joey Massino
Joey Massino brought the Bonanno mob family back after it was destroyed by the FBI.

title: Mobsters
description:
S03 E05 — Anthony \"Gaspipe\" Casso
During the 1970s, Anthony Cassa became the underboss of the Lucchese family.

title: Mobsters
description:
S03 E02 — Danny Greene
Irish mobster Danny Greene clashed with the Cleveland mafia; a bombing war that would eventually destroy them both.

title: Mobsters
description:
S03 E03 — Albert Anastasia
As leader of Murder, Inc., Albert Anastasia became one of the most vicious and feared mob bosses of the twentieth century.

title: Mobsters
description:
S04 E02 — Family Secrets
Frank Calabrese Jr., son of mobster Frank Calabrese, flipped against his father, and nearly brought down the vaunted Chicago Outfit.

title: Mobsters
description:
S04 E03 — \"Mad Sam\" DeStefano
"Mad Sam" DeStefano had a three-decade reign as a juice loan lender and sadistic enforcer with the notorious Chicago Outfit.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E05 — Murder in Tallahassee
When Brandi Peters and her three children were found murdered, prosecutors pointed the finger at her ex, but as the trial got underway, an imprisoned drug dealer came forward.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E07 — The Dallas Love Triangle Murder
Dentist Dr. Kendra Hatcher was in a deep romance with fellow doctor Ricardo Paniagua when she was brutally murdered in the garage of her apartment building.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E11 — The Jazz Musician's Murder
Jazz trumpet player Scott Sessions fails to show up for a gig; his body is found a few days later, wrapped in plastic, partially burned and hidden in a forest; investigators trace his last known whereabouts to the residence of his new love interest.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E08 — A Mother's Secret
In 1993, a newborn baby's body is discovered; the coroner determines the baby had been born alive; after 25 years, and with the assistance of modern DNA techniques, Gail Eastwood-Ritchey is found guilty of murder and sentenced to life in prison.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E10 — Murder in a Cul-de-Sac
On a summer night, Amanda Colley returns to a ransacked house; her love interest Lamar and two girlfriends arrive to join her, and gunshots ring out; Amanda and her friend Lindy are found dead.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E06 — Murder in Broward County
An heir to the Halliburton oil dynasty fortune, Jill Halliburton Su, is found dead in the bathtub by her son Justin at her upscale home in a Florida gated community in 2014.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E08 — Cheerleader on Trial
High school senior Skylar Richardson tells no one of her pregnancy; however, she is charged with murder after a newborn baby's body is found buried in her family's backyard.
